environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application code deployed behind the same ALB, but with an AWS WAF WebACL attached to the ALB. The WebACL includes a custom rate-based rule (not the AWS managed rules) configured with a threshold of 100 requests per 5-minute window, evaluated per source IP, scoped to URI paths matching the regex pattern '/api/invoices/[0-9]+'. The rule action is BLOCK, returning HTTP 429. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter on 4xx responses that triggers an SNS alert after 50 blocked requests. The WAF rule uses forwarded-for header inspection with fallback to source IP for rate aggregation.

config.alb: default listener rules, WAF WebACL attached
config.cloudwatch_alert: metric filter on WAF BLOCK count > 50
